title: Phase 2: explanations, feature discovery with comments, and frozen bundles (S3-S5)
description:
## Purpose

Phase 2: add explanations to feature discovery, finish rounds 2–3, freeze every arm as a classifier bundle, and score the reloaded bundles on paper-600.

## Scope

L2 explanation labeler with human leakage review, live rounds 2–3, bundle freeze and reload, final paper-600 run, results write-up, and the owner decisions that gate them.

## Definition of done

S5 reached and results published. Cost: ≈$3.0 Jev (rounds 2–3 ≈$1.75, final ≈$1.20) plus ≤300 small OpenAI labeler calls, inside the 7,500-request ledger.

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §1.2, §2, §5, §6 steps 7–10.

## Companion-project coordination

- [Decision-Flywheel](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-7284b9aa-7c87-4bd4-b5d3-f7a67546cbdd`.

These are cross-repository references; local Kanbus blocked-by relationships encode prerequisites within this repository.

comments.text:
Phase 2 live plan, prepared and gate-checked, NOT executed. Run from the Evaluations repo root with
P="UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_CORE=/Users/home/Projects/Decision-Flywheel/src /Users/home/Projects/Jev-Flywheel/.venv312/bin/python scripts/unified_flywheel.py" and S=var/unified-flywheel/phase2-live-seed1. Each stage has its own new ledger file.

1. Comments (OpenAI gpt-6-luna, 0 Jev). Expected 172 calls (300 labels, 128 skipped by hash), cap 300:
   $P comments --live --confirm --model gpt-6-luna --seed 1 --rounds 3 --out var/unified-flywheel/comments-seed1.l2.jsonl --cache var/unified-flywheel/labeler-cache.jsonl --spend-ledger var/unified-flywheel/spend-ledger.labeler.json --max-calls 300 > var/unified-flywheel/labeler-seed1.log 2>&1
   Replay check ($0): same command with --replay instead of --live --confirm --spend-ledger/--max-calls, and a different --out; files must match.
2. Seed the run dir with the Phase 1 caches (no analyst replies, no workspaces) and freeze 0/F/F-rand by replay ($0, offline; verified today: metrics identical to the live run, 0 requests):
   mkdir -p $S && cp var/unified-flywheel/flywheel-live-seed1/{answers.jsonl,list-answers.jsonl,run-manifest.json} $S/
   $P run --replay --provider-model jev-1.13.0 --run-dir $S --arms 0,F,F-rand --rounds 3 > $S.replay.log 2>&1
3. Live rounds 1-3 on dev-100 for A-c and A-c+F with comments (arm 0 free). Gate upper bound 5,100 (A-c 1,100; A-c+F 4,000); expected about 3,000-3,900 (Phase 1: A 900, A-c+F 2,410; the seeded list cache covers the round-1 holistic answers):
   $P run --live --confirm --arms 0,A-c,A-c+F --rounds 3 --comments var/unified-flywheel/comments-seed1.l2.jsonl --run-dir $S --spend-ledger var/unified-flywheel/spend-ledger.phase2-rounds.json --request-ceiling 5100 --max-new-requests 5100 --provider-model jev-1.13.0 > $S.rounds3.log 2>&1
4. Final: paper-600 through the reloaded round-3 bundles (no rounds run). Gate upper bound 3,000 (600 per bundle); expected about 2,400 (arm 0's paper-600 answers ship with the fixtures):
   $P run --live --confirm --final --arms 0,A-c,F,F-rand,A-c+F --rounds 3 --run-dir $S --spend-ledger var/unified-flywheel/spend-ledger.phase2-final.json --request-ceiling 3000 --max-new-requests 3000 --provider-model jev-1.13.0 > $S.final.log 2>&1
   Outputs: $S/final-summary.json (text-free) beside the rounds' $S/summary.json.

Total Jev upper bound 8,100 (5,100 + 3,000), expected about 5,400-6,300. Owner check: the gate's caps (5,100 and 3,000) exceed this epic's pre-approved hard caps (3,400 for rounds, 2,400 for the final) because the gate counts a fresh, uncached run; expected spend is within or near them.
